video_prompt: This 30-second vertical promotional video uses a cinematic dark mode interface style with monospace fonts to demonstrate the QR Code Generator tool on ToolsRift. The video opens on a problem hook, cuts to a real screen recording of the tool being used in a browser, transitions to a list of core benefits, and finishes with a direct call to action. The single idea to land is that creating custom QR codes requires no signups or software installations and happens entirely inside your browser.

vo.text: Need a custom QR code right now?
Select your settings and watch the code generate instantly.
Your files stay entirely local because nothing uploads to any server.
Completely free with no daily limits.
No sign-up required to use it.
Generate your next QR code right now on ToolsRift at toolsrift.com.

editorial: By processing everything locally inside your browser, this utility ensures your generation requests never touch an external server for complete data privacy.
